title: Evidence Envelope, version 2
description: Common envelope for every stage's evidence. ResultKind selects the payload shape; the envelope version covers the envelope only, so a payload changing shape is a payload change and not an envelope one.

resultSchemaVersion.description: Shape of this envelope. Version 1 was the Increment 1 result, which named this field schemaVersion and could be mistaken for the manifest version.

resultKind.description: Which stage produced this. Required, so a consumer never infers the shape from whichever fields happen to be present.

manifestSchemaVersion.description: Manifest version the run consumed. Absent when a stage consumed no manifest.

outcome.description: passed: the stage did what it was asked. failed: an expected failure it is designed to report. incomplete: the stage could not finish cleanly, so its own state is not fully known.

toolVersion.description: Runtime that produced the evidence, so a result is attributable.
